plan.title: A 10:30 pm step inside quiet hours the tester set themselves: one question, a no accepted, never asked again

context.text: btw don't text me after 10, that's my wind-down time
Got it, nothing from me after 10 pm. When do you want to read, and for how long?

transcript.text: 10:30 pm in bed, 20 minutes, every night

Love it, Atomic Habits in bed every night. One catch: 10:30 falls after your 10 pm cutoff, so I couldn't text you a nudge or check in around reading time. Want me to push your wind-down start to 11 pm so I can reach you before and after you read?
nah keep them, I don't need a reminder
Sounds good, quiet hours stay as they are. Is there somewhere you want this reading habit to take you, like finishing the book by a certain date? "Not sure yet" is a fine answer too.

Reading Atomic Habits right before sleep is a good pick. Here's the plan:

• Tonight, 10:30 pm: read 20 minutes in bed, starting from page one (or wherever you left off)
• Every night at 10:30 pm, 20 minutes, in bed
• Proof: after you read, send a voice note on what stuck with you. A photo of your page works too.
• Why: the same spot at the same time makes it easy to repeat, and saying the idea out loud helps it stick.

I'll reach you earlier in the day, before your 10 pm cutoff. Each night shapes the next step, so we build as we go.

What do you think?
Locked in, Priya! Day 1 is tonight at 10:30 pm: 20 minutes of Atomic Habits in bed. Then send me your voice note whenever you're done. Let's go 📖

grade.summary: ZOH handled the chosen quiet hours correctly: it asked once, accepted the no without re-asking and never raised it again after locking. The sequence slipped, though: it showed the plan after 'looks good' instead of asking for the commitment, so the lock rested on a weak 'What do you think?' rather than a real commitment ask.
